# each inside each inside each
each-nested
# map inside map
map lengths_of
# a failure two loops down ends every loop: an int has no length
map lengths_two_deep
# filter inside map
map lists_of
# any inside filter
filter has_list
# find inside filter, with an extra argument passed down
filter holds_more_than 2
filter holds_more_than 9
# all inside any
any all_are_lists
# each inside map, and the map still collects every member
map count_members
